reviews.title: Bring back ai eraser
reviews.text: This app was sooo good at removing stuff but only with the ai eraser, the regular eraser sucks. Now the ai eraser is gone and I’m no longer using this app until it’s fixed.

reviews.title: Downhill App
reviews.text: This app use to be amazing. I liked the eraser tool but I especially loved the AI eraser tool. It gave me amazing and almost flawless results. Now there’s not even an option to use the AI eraser. It’s just a normal eraser option and it doesn’t fill it with any type of common background…. Just completely erases the object from the picture without fillers. Literally a hole in the picture. Idk what’s going on but I’ve canceled my subscription until the issue is resolved.

reviews.title: Falsely Charged Me Twice
reviews.text: This app offered me a free trial months ago which I took and immediately cancelled. Luckily I was refunded when they wrongly charged me. Then fast forward to now, I downloaded the same app again and was offered another free trial. I took it since it was being offered and went to cancel it immediately. Then when it came time to “renew”, I was wrongly charged again. They will not refund me since they see that i’ve already done the trial once. The app needs to be restructured to not offer someone a free trial more than once when it is a lie. They have stolen my money and it was really not worth it because the app isn’t even good.
